### The Son of Encouragement - Greg Laurie Daily Devotion - November 3, 2016
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/the-son-of-encouragement-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-november-3-2016.html
Passage: Acts 9:26
Points:
- Following his conversion, Saul faced suspicion and fear from the Jerusalem believers rather than a warm welcome.
- New believers today often encounter similar coldness or judgment when visiting churches while still rough around the edges.
- Christians must practice patience and grace toward newcomers rather than maintaining unrealistic expectations.
- Barnabas put his personal credibility on the line to stand alongside Saul and validate his genuine faith.
- The church needs believers who follow Barnabas's example by comforting, motivating, and lifting up others.

### Day 238: Acts 9:27–31
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-238-acts-9-2731.html
Passage: Acts 9:27
Points:
- Saul experienced painful rejection and isolation when the Jerusalem disciples refused to believe he was truly converted.
- Barnabas stepped into the gap, extending fellowship and risking vulnerability to support a discouraged brother.
- Even when others were skeptical, Barnabas lived up to his nickname by championing Saul before the apostles.
- Saul's fearless preaching quickly stirred up conflict, leading the brethren to send him away to Tarsus for safety.
- God calls believers to be modern-day encouragers who give others a second chance and build up the church.
